1. #727 - Compile jar with android-support-v4 compatible with ActionBarSherlock
2. #599 - Problem with AppCompat v21
3. #814 - PanelSlideListener called too often
4. #812 - EditText or Button behind Sliding panel Up receives the onClick
5. #808 - The whole panel responds to tap/click once expanded instead of only the top part
6. #807 - Cannot draw recycled bitmaps
7. #756 - setDragView supposed to restrict the drag area (still possible to drag using the entire sliding panel)
8. #754 - Ghosting/banding when Activity's windowBackground is set to @null
9. #746 - Sliding up panel crashes with Navigation Drawer
10. #683 - Android 2.X & AppCompat hide/show ActionBar
11. #619 - MainView intercepting clicks
12. #583 - OnPanelSlide called by showPanel()
13. #567 - Not possible to change from hidden to collapsed state
14. #540 - PointerIndex out of range in ViewDragHelper
15. #535 - EditText soft keyboard positioning
16. #492 - Stuck with PanelState.DRAGGING after device rotation
17. #479 - setPanelState does not work until onMeasure is called
18. #448 - umanoInitialState set to expanded does not parallax the panel
19. #395 - Difficult page swiping when using ViewPager with scrollable View
20. #381 - Occasional NullPointerException in SavedState.writeToParcel

All issues were filtered using the BUG label filter on GitLab, ensuring only issues with BUG-related labels are included.
